evals.prompt: Review the skill in po-check/. Users complain it behaves inconsistently on each run and burns too many tokens. Refactor it and write the updated skill under outputs/po-check/.
evals.expected_output: Lint findings, separation of deterministic script work vs. model judgment, parameterized Python script with passing tests, and SKILL.md reduced to a condition -> command router.
expectations: Skill is linted with scripts/skill_lint.py and findings (unmentioned script, untested script, vague terms) are listed
Steps are split between deterministic scripts and model judgment (currency conversion and approval calls stay with the model)
A parameterized script handles numeric reconciliation and passes unit tests
Updated SKILL.md includes a situation -> command table and cites script filenames with .py
Updated skill passes scripts/skill_lint.py with zero ERROR and zero WARNING findings
Response is written in English; updated skill is placed under outputs/po-check and response.md is saved
